source.title: 变分方法及其在非线性偏微分方程应用方面的进展和未决问题

trace.notes: Input normalized as a single zbMATH resolver URL. Direct zbMATH page fetch was blocked by Cloudflare challenge with HTTP 403.

zbMATH REST API identified document 6961289 as Wenming Zou, DOI 10.16357/j.cnki.issn1000-5862.2018.02.01, title 'Results and open problems of the variational method with applications to nonlinear partial differential equations'.
DOI resolution through chndoi returned resolver metadata for the same work, including the Chinese title used here, CNKI links, and the CNKI identifier CAPE201802001.

Bounded exact-work recovery did not produce readable full text. CNKI and oversea CNKI detail/download endpoints for CAPE201802001 returned 404 or 418, HEP cjournal search/API returned no matching article for the DOI/title, and exact searches for the DOI, title, and CNKI identifier did not recover a same-work PDF or full HTML source. Failure modes encountered: blocked_or_challenged, metadata_only, and missing_or_invalid_artifact.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6961289.json and outputs/latest.json.
